## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      7 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 15.07.2026 - 10.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Db_, 08.09.2026, 1/5: "This is a open source app and opensource apps always comes with lot of bugs and problem i have never seen an open source app that works flawless. they just can get it right. Normally opening excel and pdf is fine but once they are being encrypted with a password it won't work or it will jump back to the beginning of the the sheet."
            2. _Jim_, 15.07.2026, 2/5: "The PDF format is not listed amongst the supported document types. Furthermore, the app has major problems when closing documents; it either takes an age to do so or freezes completely and crashes. And whilst using the app, pages – even though they have already loaded correctly and are still visible via their thumbnails – often become inaccessible after just a few seconds. Even scrolling manually does not display the individual page."
            3. _Cringe Guy_, 06.09.2026, 3/5: "App needs serious attention and care. It's getting unusable and annoying. Bugs, crashes and freezes making it hard to work on this app. This is the only .odf format android app and it is being neglected. This is sad and disappointing."
<!--/ir-theme-->
